requirement.description: The StructLayout.const() method doesn't properly validate the type of the initialization value. It raises a TypeError with a generic message instead of the expected specific error message.
requirement.contract: The StructLayout.const() method should raise a TypeError with the exact message "Layout constant initializer must be a mapping or a sequence, not 'object'" when passed an invalid initializer type like object().

requirement.description: View.__getitem__ method incorrectly handles array layout indexing with non-value objects. It should raise a TypeError with a specific message when trying to index array layout with a value.
requirement.contract: When accessing an array layout with a value index, View.__getitem__ should raise a TypeError with the message "Only views with array layout, not StructLayout({}), may be indexed with a value".

requirement.description: The View.__getattr__ method doesn't provide proper error messages for missing attributes. It should suggest the closest matching field names when an attribute is not found.
requirement.contract: When accessing a non-existent attribute on a View, the error message should suggest the closest matching field names using difflib.get_close_matches.

requirement.description: ArrayLayout.__getitem__ method raises incorrect error message when indexing with wrong type. It should raise TypeError with message "Cannot index array layout with 'str'" instead of "Cannot index array layout with ".
requirement.contract: ArrayLayout.__getitem__ should raise TypeError with message "Cannot index array layout with 'str'" when indexing with non-integer type.

requirement.description: EnumMeta.as_shape() method raises wrong error message when an enumeration has no members. It should provide a clearer error message.
requirement.contract: When calling as_shape() on an enum with no members, it should raise TypeError with message "Enumeration 'module.ClassName' does not have a defined shape".
